title: Absent from the text is not a fault
statement: A wrong option absent from the text is usually a sound contrast, so never report absence from the text as a defect on its own.
example: Across 11 lessons, nearly every wrong option flagged for being absent from the text was a well-made contrast.
detail: The reading audit flagged wrong options that share no words with the story, and across 11 lessons nearly every hit was a well-made contrast distractor, absent from the story because it was wrong. The flag was demoted to information and must never be reported as a defect on its own, since reusing the story's words would make a distractor easier to eliminate, not harder.

evidence.quote: `DISTRACTOR-UNGROUNDED` is deliberately `info` and must never be reported as a defect on its own.

Across 11 lessons nearly every hit was a *well-made* contrast distractor — for *"Who lives in the Wild Wood besides Badger?"* the wrong animal sets are absent from the story **because they are wrong**.
Reusing story vocabulary would make a distractor easier to eliminate, not harder, so the premise is inverted for this common, correct pattern.
